name: Ast Kikorie
description: Ast Kikorie, also called "Down Below," was a planet in the Moddell sector located in the Outer Rim Territories of the galaxy. It was a Galactic Republic astrocartographic research outpost with a ring of orbiting telescopes connected to Kikorie City by a skyhook. The planet was abandoned by the Republic at the onset of the Clone Wars in 22 BBY.
